caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with delicate toppings: a halved soft-boiled egg, nori, chashu, and menma, artfully arranged. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the glass.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved strips with a smooth, glossy surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a firm white, with a slightly glossy surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
